question: Do the PSSN 2014 conference abstracts or ATI research roster provide a reusable, site-resolved fish checklist for Dagupan's river system or Buenlag-Sabangan River?

method.summary: Reviewed the complete PSSN 14th Annual National Scientific Convention/Conference programme and abstract PDF and the linked Agricultural Training Institute EHDRP research/graduates roster. No full study manuscript, raw species table, map, station list or individual study correspondence was retrieved.
method.scopeFinding: The PSSN booklet has separate abstracts for aquatic fauna in Dagupan City's river system and for stakeholder participation in the Buenlag-Sabangan River in Binmaley. They are distinct locality leads; the booklet does not provide sampling dates, station names, fish methods, coordinates or taxon-by-station data for either abstract.
method.accessLeadFinding: The ATI roster lists Marjorie A. Villanueva, LGU-Dagupan City, Pangasinan, PSU Agriculture, graduated, with the research title 'Assessment of the Aquatic Fauna in the River System of Dagupan City.' This is a research-title roster entry, not the thesis or dataset, and the reviewed sources do not establish that it is the same project or sampling as the PSSN 2014 abstract.

retrievalFollowUp.searchScope: Bounded public-web searches used the exact and variant study titles, Marjorie A. Villanueva's name with Dagupan/PSU/aquatic-fauna terms, and PSU institutional-domain queries.
results: Queries returned the same PSSN conference abstract and ATI EHDRP roster entry; no full thesis, study report, station list, raw species table or data file was located.
Third-party document-library results were mirrors of the same conference programme, not copies of the underlying Dagupan study.
retrievalFollowUp.limitation: This search does not establish that the full work is unavailable or absent from non-indexed library holdings.

conference.venue: Benguet State University, La Trinidad, Benguet
conference.accessStatus: Official PSSN-hosted programme and abstract PDF reviewed online on 2026-11-19; no item-specific reuse license identified.

affiliationsAsPrinted: City Agriculture Office, City of Dagupan
dagupanRiverSystemAbstract.distributionStatement: The abstract says the species were almost the same at all stations, with abundance differing among sampling areas; it does not name stations or provide per-station taxa/counts.

mostAbundantTaxonStringsAsPrinted.transcriptionNote: Visual inspection of printed page 58 reads 'Apogon spp.'; the publisher PDF text extraction reads 'Agpogon spp.' and an indexed text rendering reads 'Apoogon spp.'. Preserve these as transcription variants; no taxon identification is inferred.

affiliationsAsPrinted: Benguet State University, La Trinidad, Benguet

entryAsPrinted.name: Villanueva, Marjorie A.
entryAsPrinted.titleOrResearch: Assessment of the Aquatic Fauna in the River System of Dagupan City

atiAccessLead.relationshipToPssnAbstract: Unconfirmed; similar project title and author do not establish that the ATI-listed research and PSSN 2014 abstract are the same survey or data.

possibleOverlap.relationship: The 2014 PSSN abstract and Cerezo et al. (2018) both concern aquatic fauna in Buenlag-Sabangan River. No field dates or underlying data crosswalk were found; the PSSN abstract reports 20 fish while the 2018 paper lists 15 fish-name strings.
possibleOverlap.disposition: Keep the publications separate as source records but do not count their survey totals independently or merge taxon lists until dates, methods and source lineage are resolved.

rights.disposition: Both documents are publicly accessible, but no specific license permitting redistribution of extracted content was identified. Public-app projection remains unapproved.

internalConsistency.issue: The Dagupan abstract claims 25 finfish species but gives no complete fish list; the only fish label is rendered 'Apogon spp.' on printed page 58, while PDF and indexed text extraction produce 'Agpogon spp.' and 'Apoogon spp.'. The only named crustacean is 'Metapenae usensis.'
internalConsistency.disposition: Preserve the page-image reading and text-extraction variants as a transcription discrepancy. Do not resolve it taxonomically or treat the aggregate count as a checklist.

internalConsistency.issue: The Dagupan abstract mentions multiple stations and variation in abundance, but provides no station names, study dates, sampling methods, counts or fish-by-station table.
internalConsistency.disposition: No exact observation date, locality point, species distribution, abundance or current-presence claim can be derived from the abstract.

internalConsistency.issue: The PSSN 2014 Buenlag-Sabangan abstract reports 20 fish and mentions 'Gerres erythrourus' and 'Tetraodon fluviatilis', while Cerezo et al. (2018) reports 15 fish-name strings for the same river; neither source provides a field-date crosswalk linking the two records.
internalConsistency.disposition: Keep the counts separate and potentially overlapping; do not add them or infer a change in richness.

internalConsistency.issue: The ATI roster's matching Dagupan research title does not state a study date or explicitly cross-reference the PSSN conference abstract.
internalConsistency.disposition: Treat it as a retrieval lead for the underlying work, not proof of identity, method, data access or a second survey.

internalConsistency.issue: Dagupan's river-system abstract does not state whether sampling locations were freshwater, brackish or tidal; the PSSN PDF has no specific reuse license for its abstracts.
internalConsistency.disposition: Keep habitat classification and content reuse unresolved; do not add map boundaries, safety claims or public species data.

interpretation: The PSSN booklet provides a useful lead to local river research, but only summary-level aggregate counts and a few source spellings. It does not provide the species coverage needed for a verified regional checklist.
Use the ATI roster only to pursue the underlying Dagupan City research through PSU or the city agriculture office; do not represent the roster as the thesis or dataset.
No normalized species assertions, occurrence rows, counts by species, waterbody geometry, current-presence claims, diet, catchability, legal status, safety advice or public-app rows were added.
Region I and Luzon remain incomplete.
nextAction: Continue the regional search with independent, site-resolved Pangasinan river evidence while keeping the ATI title as an access lead; if a full Dagupan study copy is later located, reconcile its dates, methods, species list and stations against the PSSN abstract before using any data.
